_comment: Demo org settings. "persona" picks the org the demo runs as: "tidepath" (FICTIONAL, the default; the hackathon rules ask for made-up data) or "miami_foundation" (the original real-org demo). Each persona's name, website and social URLs (onboarding screen 2) live in service/personas/<persona>/persona.json; DONOR_DESK_PERSONA overrides this key. See service/persona.py.

targets._comment: SAMPLE goals for the demo, invented for Donor Desk: not any real organization's targets. Edit freely. 'default' applies to every period; a key like '2026-11' (month) or '2026-Q4' (quarter) overrides one period. Read by service/targets.py; the context stage ignores this key.
